tools.capability_verification_scope: Interactive browser tests only; not API integration or proof of deterministic frame adherence.
verified_workflow_features: Save Last Frame from Media Library
select saved endpoint from My AI Images for next prompt

generation_policy.preflight_gate: verify selected reference thumbnail against source endpoint, replace sample text in both prompt fields, and verify aspect ratio, image type and duration before each render
generation_policy.retry_rule: one targeted retry after diagnosing a specific defect; never repeat an unchanged prompt
generation_policy.save_endpoint_action: Media Library > My Videos > clip context menu > Save Last Frame > verify My AI Images; avoids seeking the timeline boundary
visual_rules: require a visible in-clip transition-in in the opening seconds
require a visible in-clip transition-out in the closing seconds
lock the principal subject identity and geometry; forbid morphing, deforming, stretching, melting, duplication or species replacement
allow gradual subject or color changes only through a plausible light, focus, refraction, bokeh or shadow reveal
place adjacent clips directly together with no editor-side transition or added duration
vary macro perspective, angles, scale, focus and photographic lighting; permit motivated tight crops and partial exits from frame
generation_policy.master_still_policy: Generate one approved still for the first clip only. Subsequent clips use the immediately preceding clip's verified saved last frame as their starting reference; create a replacement still only when that endpoint is missing or unusable.

preserve: subject identity and anatomy (not fixed screen position, scale, or full-frame visibility)
transitions.subject_or_color_change: gradual physically plausible optical or lighting reveal of a separate subject; never morph or deform the principal subject; camera framing may crop or let a subject leave frame without morphing
transitions.next_clip_adherence: use the saved actual endpoint and pair its light/shape/color cue with the next in-clip entry; generated adherence must be reviewed
transitions.visual_framing_policy: Creative extreme-macro framing is encouraged: vary angle, perspective, scale, focus, raking/rim light and camera path; intentional tight crops, partial visibility and subjects leaving frame are allowed when anatomy remains coherent and the transition is motivated.
